new_destinations.name: ʻEua
new_destinations.name_evidence: Wikivoyage has a page 'ʻEua' and Tonga Tourism lists it at tongatourism.travel/our-islands/eua as one of Tonga's islands; travellers go to ʻEua as a hiking island (Pocket Guide: 5 best hikes in ʻEua).
new_destinations.why_not_park: ʻEua National Park is 4.5 km2 inside an 87 km2 island, and its kept neighbours (Rock Gardens, caves, beaches) lie outside it, so the island is the region travellers name and the park is a spot. Overlaps no existing destination (none in Tonga yet).

spots.name: ʻEua National Park
spots.coordinates_source: pending resolve-pin.py (candidate is the Wikipedia park centre; needs a visitor point)
spots.bio: Tonga's only forest national park, a rainforest band above the east-coast sea cliffs with caves, chasms and walking tracks.
spots.reason: Park named by Wikivoyage and Tonga Tourism. Kept as a spot of the ʻEua island destination: 4.5 km2, too small to be a destination beside the island it sits in. Coordinates are the park centre; pin stage must take a visitor point (day-use area, trailhead or main lookout), not the centroid.

spots.name: Rock Gardens
spots.coordinates_source: Tonga Pocket Guide page geo tag (guidebook map pin)
spots.bio: Clifftop rock outcrops on ʻEua's south coast, about 30 minutes to explore beside Lakufaʻanga Cliffs.
spots.reason: Tourism board and Pocket Guide name it; south-coast cluster reached from ʻEua's base. Adjacent to Lakufaʻanga Cliffs (about 200 m) but kept as a separate kept place; pin stage may merge the two into one stop if one pin is wanted.

spots.name: Lakufaʻanga Cliffs
spots.coordinates_source: Tonga Pocket Guide page geo tag (guidebook map pin)
spots.bio: Sea cliffs at the southern tip of ʻEua with seabirds, an interpretation panel and views along the coast.
spots.reason: Tourism board and Pocket Guide name it; the same south-coast stop as Rock Gardens, kept separately because both were kept.

spots.name: Big Ovava Tree
spots.bio: A banyan-type tree said to be over 800 years old, the main attraction inside ʻEua National Park.
spots.reason: Wikivoyage calls it the park's main attraction; a distinct natural landmark reached by a 3-hour hike.

spots.name: Liʻangahuo ʻa Maui
spots.coordinates_source: OSM viewpoint 'Li'anga Huo A Maui (Natural Archway)' (node 12464909371)
spots.bio: A natural stone land-bridge in ʻEua's southern cliffs, reached by a short walk east from the Rock Gardens.
spots.reason: Tourism board and Pocket Guide name it; short walk from the south-coast stops.

spots.name: Haʻaluma Beach
spots.coordinates_source: Tonga Pocket Guide page geo tag (guidebook map pin)
spots.bio: A small south-coast beach with large tidal pools for snorkelling, reached by a steep sandy road.
spots.reason: Tourism board and Pocket Guide name it as a swim stop. Pin is a Pocket Guide geo tag; pin stage should confirm against OSM natural/beach.

spots.name: ʻOtumatafena Tidal Pools
spots.coordinates_source: pending resolve-pin.py (approximate shore midpoint between Ohonua and Tufuvai)
spots.bio: A reef shore of small tidal pools at sea level on ʻEua's west coast between ʻOhonua and Tufuvai.
spots.reason: Tourism board highlight; single counted source, kept by the skeptic. Coordinates are an approximate midpoint, so the pin must be resolved.

spots.name: Cathedral Cave
spots.coordinates_source: OSM cave_entrance Grand Cathedral cave and submarine cavern (node 6538601037)
spots.bio: An underwater cavern about 30 m down and 100 m long, with daylight through ceiling openings, visited on guided dives.
spots.reason: Tourism board and Pocket Guide name it; the draw is the cavern itself, reached by dive operator from ʻEua. Dive-only access noted for research.

not_placed_review.name: ʻEua National Park Coastal Walk
not_placed_review.reason: Likely the same ground as the Lakufaanga/Rock Gardens or Lokupo hikes, so a near-duplicate and unpinnable.

not_placed_review.name: Matalanga ʻa Maui
not_placed_review.reason: A pothole, short look, no coordinates, no second source; likely under 30 minutes.

not_placed_review.name: ʻAna ʻAhu
not_placed_review.reason: Little visitor detail, access needs a guide.

not_placed_review.name: Tufuvai Beach
not_placed_review.reason: Small beach mainly for nearby guesthouse guests; one source.

not_placed_review.name: Lokupo Lookout
not_placed_review.reason: Part of the Lokupo hike and the park; one source.

notes: No Tonga destinations or spots exist yet. No standalone spots in this region, so none lies within 40 km of the new destination.
Ids use eua-island-N to avoid the eua-N ids in git history on commit c7d43b63 (another branch).
Review items are not placed; listed in not_placed_review for the owner.

Coordinates left to pin stage: park (visitor point) and tidal pools; others come from OSM nodes or guidebook geo tags, to be re-confirmed by resolve-pin.py (Rock Gardens, Lakufaʻanga, Haʻaluma are guidebook pins).
Cathedral Cave pin is OSM cave_entrance; underwater site 10 km north of the other stops.
